title: Stamp release snippets with a named version capture over a glob

setupFiles.monochange.toml:
[defaults]
parent_bump = "patch"
[package."@acme/api"]
path = "packages/api"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/ui"]
path = "packages/ui"
type = "npm"
[package."@acme/tokens"]
path = "packages/tokens"
type = "npm"
[group.main]
packages = ["@acme/api", "@acme/ui", "@acme/tokens"]
version_format = "primary"
[ecosystems.npm]
enabled = true
[lints.rules]
"npm/workspace-protocol" = "off"

prompt: Both install/*/install.sh scripts need their SDK_VERSION updated whenever the main group releases, while TOOL_VERSION stays independent. Configure one regex versioned_files glob entry on main, using a named version capture, then prepare the pending minor release locally. Do not execute the installer scripts or publish anything.
expectation: One group-scoped regex glob stamps SDK_VERSION=2.4.0 in both files while unrelated tool versions remain 8.0.0/9.0.0.

checks.why: The script stamp must match the prepared release.
The glob must cover every installer while the named capture limits replacement.
Hand edits do not implement recurring installer stamping.
Evaluation is limited to local planning and preparation; registry, tag, release, and push operations are outside the task.
